d:
Enjoy The Beautiful “I Love You - Jeeva Hoovagide” Lyrical Song From The Evergreen Kannada Movie Nee Nanna Gellalare, Starring The Legendary Dr. Rajkumar And Manjula.
Relive The Timeless Melody And Nostalgic Charm Of Classic Kannada Cinema With This Beautiful Lyrical Song.
If You Enjoy Dr. Rajkumar Songs, Manjula Songs, Ilaiyaraaja Kannada Songs, Kannada Old Songs, Evergreen Kannada Melodies, Classic Kannada Movie Songs And Vintage Kannada Hits.
Directed by: Vijay
Produced by: S.A. Srinivas
Artist Name: Rajkumar, Manjula, K. S. Ashwath, Balakrishna
Music Director: Ilaiyaraaja
